remarks: Welcome home to this beautifully appointed 2-bedroom, 1-bath second-floor condo, offering the perfect blend of comfort and convenience. This inviting residence features a thoughtful layout ideal for first-time buyers, downsizers, or savvy investors. Enjoy the rare luxury of a private garage plus an additional assigned parking space - a true commuter's dream. The unit's elevated second-floor position offers added privacy and natural light throughout. Location is everything, and 11 Bedford Ave delivers. You're just minutes from Route 1's premier shopping, dining, and everyday essentials, with quick access to both major parkways making your commute effortless in any direction. Don't miss this opportunity to own a low-maintenance home in one of the area's most accessible neighborhoods.
